subject: Penetration test evidence handoff, NDA and redaction workflow
messages:
From: Olivia Greene <olivia.greene@acme-payments.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Payments Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Request for penetration test report and exec summary (NDA/redaction)

Hi Avery,

Following our SOC 2 readiness review, our security team would like to review the most recent penetration test report and a one-page executive summary that highlights SOC 2-relevant findings and remediation timelines. We understand full reports are sensitive — we're happy to sign an NDA and accept redactions where needed, but we'd like to see the raw finding descriptions, severity, and remediation ETA columns if possible.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood share the report under an NDA (we can share a template)?
- Do you have a standard redaction workflow/annotations matrix we can use so both sides agree on what's removed?

If useful, I can loop in our CISO (cc'd) and legal to speed review. Our timeline is tight — can we aim to have a sanitized copy within 7 business days? We are also open to a short live walkthrough of the findings.

Thanks,
Olivia Greene
Head of Security Operations
Acme Payments
[Attachment: acme_request_ndas.zip]

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Greene <olivia.greene@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and exec summary (NDA/redaction)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the note and the clear asks. We can absolutely support this. High-level options we typically offer:

1) Full report (PDF) under a mutual NDA + agreed redaction matrix — we provide a redaction proposal then produce a secured PDF.
2) Limited executive summary (1–2 pages) that omits exploit details but includes severity, impacted components, and remediation ETA — available without NDA.
3) Evidence bundle (screenshots/scan logs) — sanitized and provided on a need-basis under tighter controls.

I've attached our suggested redaction_template_v1.xlsx and a short handoff checklist. What I propose as next steps:
- Acme sends NDA (or we can provide ours). Legal (Priyom) will do a quick review.
- We agree the redaction rules in the spreadsheet — e.g., redact IP, precise exploit PoC, but keep findings, severity, and remediation columns.
- Target: once NDA signed, we can produce a redacted PDF and a separate remediation snapshot within 5 business days.

If you confirm you can receive the report under NDA, I'll ask Karthik to prepare the redaction markup and a remediation snapshot for your review. If you'd like a walkthrough, we can schedule 30–45 minutes next week.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: redaction_template_v1.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed redaction levels and evidence handoff

Avery / team —

Quick draft of what we can deliver and why:

Redaction levels:
- Level 0 (Executive): finding title, severity, impacted service, remediation ETA, executive impact statement.
- Level 1 (Operational): includes Level 0 + high-level technical summary (no PoC, no raw logs).
- Level 2 (Full under NDA): includes Level 1 + PoC details and selected sanitized evidence (screenshots with sensitive fields redacted).

Evidence handoff approach:
- Produce Level 2 PDF for Acme once mutual NDA in place; include a separate remediation snapshot CSV (finding_id, severity, status, owner, eta).
- Maintain an embargo window of 30 days post-delivery where we handle any follow-up questions directly (no redistribution without written consent).

Open items / ETA:
- We need confirmation on whether Acme requires the raw scan outputs (they asked for logs). If so, we'll offer sanitized logs with identifier redaction.
- Legal (Priyom) will run the NDA; estimate 48 hours for first pass.

I'll prepare the redaction markup over the next 48 hours and the remediation snapshot for Avery to route.

-Karthik
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme_pen_test_v2_draft.pdf (redaction draft)]

From: Olivia Greene <olivia.greene@acme-payments.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Payments Legal <legal@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and exec summary (NDA/redaction)

Thanks — that sounds reasonable. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Timeline: Acme needs the Level 2 redacted report and remediation snapshot within 5 business days of NDA execution.
- Scope: please flag any findings that directly affect cardholder data or tokenization systems and mark them as highest priority.
- NDA: attaching our standard mutual NDA. Our legal team prefers to avoid an embargo longer than 14 days; can you share a rationale for 30 days?

Also, we do have an external MFT vendor who will ingest the sanitized evidence for our internal review — do they need a separate NDA or can we sign on a subprocessor addendum? Please advise.

Attached: ACME_Mutual_NDA_v3.pdf

Olivia

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Greene <olivia.greene@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report and exec summary (NDA/redaction)

Olivia —

Appreciate the clarity. Quick responses to your points:

- ETA: We're aligned on your 5-business-day requirement post-NDA. We can meet that once the NDA is executed and redaction rules are confirmed.
- Cardholder-data findings: Karthik will flag any findings that touch tokenization or CDE and assign them HP (highest priority) in the remediation snapshot.
- Embargo rationale: the 30-day embargo is to allow coordinated disclosure internally and to ensure any remediation actions are not publicized prematurely. That said, we can negotiate to 14 days if Acme's legal requires it — propose adding it as a field in the NDA so both parties are explicit.
- Third-party ingestion: Priyom suggests a subprocessor addendum for the MFT vendor — this maintains the audit trail and access controls. If Acme prefers, we can accept a signed Subprocessor Addendum from the vendor instead of a separate NDA.

Next steps I will take now:
1) Priyom will review the Acme NDA and propose a 1–2 line carveout to make redaction expectations explicit.
2) Karthik will finalize the redaction markup and remediation snapshot and share the Level 2 PDF gated behind DocuSign / secure transfer.
3) I'll send a DocuSign for the agreed NDA (or comment on your version) and include the proposed embargo term.

If that works, please confirm and we'll begin the legal review. I'll also open a secure transfer link once NDA is in place.

Best,
Avery
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Related link: https://docusign.com/embedded-signing/ABC123]
